Name: Fashion Sense UI for DaisyNiko's Earthy Interface
Author: EtaMyosotis
Description:
[size=3]I realised that no one seemed to be making a UI for FashionSense that suited the Earthy Interface, so I made my own.

For use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13658]DaisyNiko's Earthy Interface[/url].

Installed:
[/size][size=3]1. Download and unzip the file.
2. Place the extracted folder into the Mods folder. The purpose of this step is to replace the original UI inside Fashion Sense with my files.If your Fashion Sense is placed in another path, please change the location according to your path.[/size]
